== Missing data ==
* Photographer of the ''Star Wars Insider'' #43 player-card portraits is unnamed on the printed pages.
* A fifth card is cut off on the right edge of p. 65 (Dark Side; printed fragments include AUTO / Explosives / Industry Mine). No player name is readable.
* Hernandez card game text names Western Oregon University; article body says Oregon. Ankrum card game text names a medical student in St. Paul, Minnesota.
* Cover barcode reads ISSUE 43; contents page titles the article "DECIPHER: THE THRILL OF VICTORY" at p. 64. Month/year is not printed on pp. 64–65.
